原文：Liu, Li, Sun, Ni 2026, arXiv 2610.28904v1（投 GRL），22 页。Zotero GV6PQBKB / 附件 DVIHW7UE；项目副本。下称页码均为 PDF 页（与稿件页脚编号一致）。

| 模型与层位 | GraphCast 0.25°（ERA5 1979–2017 训练）；16 个 processor 层，每层 40,962 网格节点 × 512 维隐状态；主分析层 Layer 8 | PDF p.5 |

# L26.12 Transfer of sparse autoencoder interpretability

**Approval**: the PI approved A289 on 10-26, pplan approve. Try R23 Pangu first. Write scope , .

## Check of the original paper (step 0, 10-26)
Original paper: Liu, Li, Sun, Ni 2026, arXiv 2610.28904v1 (submitted to GRL), 22 pages. Zotero GV6PQBKB / attachment DVIHW7UE; project copy. All page numbers below are PDF pages (matching the manuscript footer numbering).

| Item checked | What the paper does | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Model and layer | GraphCast 0.25° (trained on ERA5 1979–2017); 16 processor layers, each with 40,962 grid nodes × 512-dimensional hidden states; main analysis layer is Layer 8 | PDF p.5 |
| SAE configuration | TopK SAE, dictionary 4,096, K=32; architecture follows MacMillan & Ouellette 2025; 5 seeds per layer (50108–50112), 80 dictionaries in total | PDF p.5, p.9 |
| **Time split for SAE training/validation/analysis** | SAE trained on 1979–2017 hidden states (no tropical cyclone labels, unsupervised), reconstruction validated on 2018–2021; tropical cyclone analysis uses only 2018–2019 | PDF p.5 |
| **Storm split** | **No storm-level training/test split.** All 205 storms, 2,115 time steps and 4,118 storm–time-step records are used in a single 2018–2019 analysis; feature **selection** (Top-1/Top-4 by median F1) and **evaluation** of the attribute correspondence are done on the same storms and the same time steps | PDF p.5, p.8–9 |
| Post hoc selection | The Top-4 count was "chosen exploratorily after viewing the full picture of the reference dictionary," then fixed for all 80 dictionaries | PDF p.9–10 |
| Attribute definitions | Position: F1 between the feature's positive activation region and the IBTrACS center + R34 mask; intensity: difference D between the minimum ERA5 sea-level pressure anomaly within the mask (not the IBTrACS maximum wind) and the maximum activation within the feature mask, each min–max normalized; structure: spatial Spearman ρ between feature activation and −p′ within ±12° (within-storm spatial correlation, not cross-storm intensity correlation) | PDF p.5–8 |
| Main numbers | Layer-8 reference dictionary f613: median F1 0.512, D 0.180, ρ 0.644; Top-1 median F1 across 5 seeds 0.345–0.512 | PDF p.9, p.11 |
| **Any intervention/ablation** | **None.** The authors state that reading out only shows "correspondence," not "use"; whether the model relies on it requires intervention or ablation (pointing to MacMillan & Ouellette 2025) | PDF p.13 |
| Limitations acknowledged by the authors | Sensitivity to SAE dictionary size, sparsity and Top-k subset size not tested; only one model, two years, single step | PDF p.13 |
| Public materials | SAE checkpoints, analysis code, processed results: Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.23492703; ERA5 inputs taken from the public WeatherBench 2 zarr (GCS) | PDF p.14–15 |

**Reading**: the paper's conclusion goes only as far as "correlation/correspondence," and selection and evaluation use the same set (selection bias not quantified); correlation between time steps is not handled (about 10 time steps per storm on average). These affect only our assessment of the paper, not this project's criteria: this project splits by storm + year and performs interventions (launch plan §2).
**Two points useful for this project**: ① the WeatherBench 2 ERA5 zarr is publicly readable, which provides a ready source for "ERA5 cloud copy to be checked" in launch plan §5/§6; ② the precedent for intervention is MacMillan & Ouellette 2025 (arXiv 2512.24440, retrieved, Zotero ANNAEAZP); the step 3 intervention method follows it.

## Literature basis (cards built by litwiki on 10-26)
- Original paper : GraphCast, features selected and evaluated on the same 2018–2019 storms, no holdout, no intervention (consistent with "Check of the original paper" on this page).

Its γ=+0.5 produced runaway, nonphysical responses in a 10-day, 40-step autoregressive forecast with re-application at every step. This project is a single 24 h step applied only once, but α=2 (γ=+1) exceeds its largest amplitude; divergence counts toward the "not judged" condition under the criteria and must be reported for each α.
